Corollary
[Matrix Harnack estimate for ancient solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0321 ↗ thm:chow-ii-hamilton-matrix-harnack 1. ch15:15.35\group Ancient Solutions and Solitons

If a complete ancient Ricci flow has bounded nonnegative curvature operator, then $\overline Q(U\oplus W)\ge 0$ for every $U,W$.
Proof

\sketch Translate an arbitrary ancient time $\alpha $ to zero and apply Theorem 2. The only $\alpha $-dependent term is $R_{ij}/(2(t-\alpha ))$. Let $\alpha \to -\infty $.

□
